text:
pavel: Preflight: 23:45 UTC change window. Targets: API v3.0.0-schema, runtime 3.6.0-quant-gpu, console 2.1.0, router 4.3.0. Window 23:45-02:15 UTC. Canary plan: 2% for 10m -> 10% for 20m -> 40% for 30m -> full. Wave id rw-17555. @rita (runtime), @kensho (router) please ack blockers.

rita: ack. Runtime 3.6.0-quant-gpu enables a new fused attention kernel and swaps to bf16 math on GPU; it also emits a new model-metadata header X-RW-Model-Hash for telemetry. We'll publish a variant runtime:3.6.0-quant-gpu-safe which keeps legacy kv and GC settings for canary.

kensho: ack. Router 4.3.0 expects the model-metadata header and includes a small grpc connection refactor (downgrade fallback to http1 if grpc fail). Console 2.1.0 will decode the model metadata but the UI change to surface the header isn't in prod yet. If console doesn't accept the header we can strip it at the router for the canary with ROUTER_STRIP_MODEL_HASH=true.

pavel: high level: proceed but 1) runtime will use the -safe variant, 2) router will set ROUTER_STRIP_MODEL_HASH=true for canary, 3) API v3.0.0-schema introduces a minor change: structured output field names renamed (tokens->generated_tokens). We need API and Console to be in sync; if console not ready we'll keep API backward-compatible switch on via API_FLAG_SCHEMA_V3=false for the canary. SRE: watch model throughput, p50/p95/p99, 5xx, and structured-output schema mismatches. Abort triggers: schema-mismatch error spikes >0.2% or p99 >850ms or 5xx >0.3%.

deploybot: queued wave rw-17555. Canary config: {"stages":[{"pct":2,"mins":10},{"pct":10,"mins":20}],"abort_on":["schema_mismatch>0.2%","p99>850ms","5xx>0.3%"]}

kensho: I'll push router canary with STRIP flag on. Command I plan to run:
```
kubectl set env deploy/router-canary ROUTER_STRIP_MODEL_HASH=true --namespace=prod-canary
```

rita: runtime variant runtime:3.6.0-quant-gpu-safe published: please make deploybot target that tag for runtime pool. It keeps bf16 math but not the new GC aggressor.

deploybot: initiating canary at 23:48 UTC. Rolling sequence: runtime -> api -> router.

deploybot: runtime:3.6.0-quant-gpu-safe -> OK on canary subset. API v3.0.0-schema (FLAG_SCHEMA_V3=false) -> OK. Router 4.3.0 (STRIP_MODEL_HASH=true) -> rolling to 2%.

deploybot: canary 2% reached at 23:58 UTC. Shortchecks: health endpoints OK, initial throughput looks steady. Watching schema mismatch counters.

sre-bot: initial health snapshot: p50 110ms p95 300ms p99 690ms. schema_mismatch rate 0.01% baseline. No infra anomalies.

pavel: good. Proceed to watch 10m window and then ramp to 10% if green.

-- 00:05 UTC --

rita: flag: I'm seeing an uptick in subtle schema mismatch logs from workers that invoke API v3. Although API_FLAG_SCHEMA_V3=false, some generated outputs still contain renamed keys in streaming frames. Sample log:
```
[00:05:12] WARN stream_frame_unexpected_field name=generated_tokens_id sample_pod=runtime-12
```
This is ~0.15% of requests in the canary. It's under abort but trending upward.

kensho: router logs show we are consistently stripping X-RW-Model-Hash; however, there's an odd path where grpc proxy preserves the header and the backend receives model-hash. I'm seeing a small set of requests forwarded via grpc-fallback with header intact.

pavel: hm. SRE, can you correlation trace those schema-mismatch traces back to router paths? If router preserved header on some paths maybe the API toggled behavior based on header presence.

sre-bot: correlation: ~95% of the mismatch traces map to route /v1/stream/infer with upstream via grpc-fallback. It looks like the API runtime toggles a compatibility shim when header present which causes partial v3 naming in streaming frames.

rita: that explains it. The runtime change includes a small output framing improvement when it sees a model-hash header; intended for telemetry but it leaked into naming. We should halt ramp and strip header everywhere until we patch.

pavel: agreed. Kensho, can you flip an env override to drop the header on all canary proxy paths immediately? If not, rollback router to 4.2.9 as a quick safety.

kensho: trying an env flip first:
```
kubectl set env deploy/router-canary ROUTER_DROP_ALL_MODEL_HEADERS=true -n prod-canary
```
Applying now.

deploybot: env override applied to router canary. Monitoring.

deploybot: after override: schema_mismatch counter fell from 0.15% -> 0.02% within 30s. Progressing to hold.

sre-bot: p99 unchanged, schema_mismatch now stable at 0.02%. No increase in 5xx.

pavel: good mitigation. Pause ramp until we have a fix. Rita, patch runtime to not change frame naming based on header presence. We'll do a minor runtime patch and re-release this behavior controlled by a feature flag.

rita: on it. I will cut runtime:3.6.1-quant-gpu which removes header-dependent naming and keeps kernel. ETA ~45m. I'll also add a unit test to prevent future leak.

kensho: I'll keep routing overrides in place and coordinate with console team so they don't flip UI bits. Console will stay on 2.1.0 but we won't expose model-hash.

-- 00:57 UTC --

rita: published runtime:3.6.1-quant-gpu-noheader. Ready for targeted redeploy to canary subset. This build removes the header-triggered naming change.

pavel: recommend we redeploy runtime only to canary subset, re-evaluate for 10m, then try a cautious ramp. Deploybot, do targeted runtime redeploy.

deploybot: redeploying runtime to runtime:3.6.1-quant-gpu-noheader on canary subset now.

deploybot: redeploy complete at 01:07 UTC. Re-evaluating schema mismatch and latencies.

sre-bot: schema_mismatch back to baseline 0.01%, p99 stable 700ms, 5xx stable at 0.04%. Safe to consider ramp.

pavel: ok to ramp to 10%? Propose keep router DROP_ALL header override for next full rollout and re-evaluate before enabling model-hash anywhere.

kensho: agree. Will hold header exposure until console UI is shipped.

pavel: ramping to 10% at 01:12 UTC. deploybot proceed.

deploybot: ramping to 10% now. Monitoring.

ops-bot: 01:35 UTC check: 10% steady, no schema mismatches, p95/p99 within baseline.

pavel: follow-ups/action items: 1) runtime: add test preventing header-triggered naming changes (rita), 2) router: make a global safe-path to strip new telemetry headers until upper-stack agrees (kensho), 3) API: add guardrail preventing schema sniffing based on headers (pavel), 4) release notes: call out model-metadata header as "telemetry-only" behind opt-in. We'll schedule enabling model-hash in a later coordinated window once console/UI and infra are prepared.

rita: filing PR and test, will schedule staging perf run for 3.6.1.

kensho: I'll convert the DROP flag into a short-lived kill-switch that defaults to true and autodeletes after 2 weeks unless opt-in requested.

deploybot: canary continues at 10% and will proceed to 40% per plan if no new abort conditions.

pavel: thanks team, nice quick mitigation and rollback-free fix. Closing thread and updating release doc.
